E3106

This unsafe gate must choose a permitted obligation mode.

What

This unsafe gate must choose a permitted obligation mode.

Why

`.PerSite` requires `.Track`/`.Skip`, and `.Skip` has no ambient meaning outside `.PerSite`.

Fix

add `obligations: .Track`, or use `.Skip` only under a package `.PerSite` policy.
